title: gen1recomp cart index entry
description: One carts/<Author>@<id>/meta.json entry. A custom cart is a version-pinned mod setup that plays as its own game: an identity, a base game, a list of mods pinned to exact builds with their options frozen, a load order, and a seal. A cart ships no code, so every mod it names is published separately and must be resolvable from a public source.

id.description: Must equal the cart bundle's id.

summary.description: One-line blurb for the card. Long form goes in description.md.

version.description: Semver of the cart bundle this entry describes.

base.description: The game the cart plays as. Same name and vocabulary as the bundle's cart.json.

seal.description: sealed: the engine loads this list and nothing else, exactly as pinned. sealed+: the list is fixed, but the player may switch a pinned mod on or off. open: the player may add more.

speeds.description: Optional. The only game-speed multipliers this cart permits. One entry pins the speed outright.

shell.description: Cart shell colour, #RRGGBB. The entry's thumbnail doubles as the label art preview.

finish.description: Optional cartridge finish: sparkle flecks the shell, holo gives the label a holographic sheen.

repo.description: Where the cart bundle lives. Any host; GitHub unlocks version tracking.

github.description: owner/repo. The index refresh job reads this repo's Releases the same way it does for a mod.

downloadURL.description: Direct link to an installable cart .zip (manifest and label art at the archive root). Required when github is absent.

automatic_version_check.description: When true and github is set, the index refresh job re-reads Releases nightly and records the newest version.

fixed_release_tag.description: Pin the index to one release tag instead of tracking the newest.

game_version.description: Engine semver range the cart needs, same grammar as the manifest.

mods.description: Every mod the cart loads, each pinned to one exact build, in the bundle's own cart.json shape. The order here is the load order unless load_order overrides it.

source.description: Where this exact build is published. github needs repo, version and sha256; gamebanana needs mod, file and md5.

repo.description: github: owner/repo the release zip comes from.

version.description: github: semver of the pinned release.

sha256.description: github: digest of the pinned zip.

file.description: gamebanana: file id of the pinned upload.

md5.description: gamebanana: digest GameBanana reports for that file.

enabled.description: Ship this mod pinned but switched off. Absent means on. Pair it with the sealed+ seal so the player can switch it on and get your settings.

options.description: The mod's option values, frozen as the cart author set them.

load_order.description: Pinned mod ids, first loaded first. Must name exactly the ids in mods. Omit to load in the order mods lists them.
